steps.en: Bring up a node from the official Docker image
steps.zh: 用官方 Docker 镜像起一个节点

steps.en: Keeps the hot working set in memory and persists the full dataset to RocksDB on local disk
steps.zh: 热数据留在内存，全量数据落到本地磁盘的 RocksDB

component.zh: 内存缓存 + RocksDB 分层

steps.en: Point your existing Redis clients at it — same protocol, no code change
steps.zh: 现有 Redis 客户端原样指过去，协议兼容、代码不改

steps.en: Answers Redis commands from disk-backed string/hash/zset structures
steps.zh: 按 Redis 协议应答，数据从落盘结构中取

steps.en: Add a replica with the Redis command you already know
steps.zh: 用你熟悉的 Redis 命令挂一个从库

steps.en: Replicates asynchronously over binlog, full and incremental
steps.zh: 通过 binlog 异步复制，支持全量与增量同步

value.en: Hundreds-of-GB nodes at SSD cost, with untouched Redis client code
value.zh: 单节点装下几百 GB、按 SSD 计价，Redis 客户端代码一行不改
